prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One full moon with five large softly outlined crater shapes of different sizes and a few curved surface marks, no texture dots, no other celestial objects. Draw flat pure black contour artwork on pure WHITE, NO gray shading, gradients, hatching or fine texture. All interiors completely WHITE. ONE square image with ample margins. Draw only the requested subject/composition. Keep beginner very simple and medium thoughtfully detailed, legible and spacious.
